parole.significato: sock (a knitted or woven covering for the foot)
parole.testo: First attested in 1906. Borrowed from Austrian German. Compare Austrian German Socken, Sockerl, and German Socke. Ultimately from Latin soccus. Suffixed with -i to resolve the word-final consonant cluster, compare cetli from Bavarian zettl or German Zettel (/⁠ˈt͡sɛtl̩⁠/) etc.
